reasoning: About 12% chance (1 in 8) of 200, joint best of the optimiser's plans, against 4% with no trades. The unlimited window before R14 rebuilds the squad anyway, so nothing is bought for the long term.

Correlation: Vezenkov (C) wins with Olympiacos; holding Maledon and Feliz in active slots bets on Madrid at the same time. This keeps Feliz (27' a night, Madrid's only fit point guard with Campazzo out) and drops Maledon.

Coach lens: Baskonia have three fit bigs, so Kamenjas (19 PIR, 31' on his debut) plays big minutes against Thiemann on Thursday. The two centres are on opposite sides, but a fast, foul-heavy game helps both, and Kamenjas only plays at 6th-man value.

Nunn stays: 21.7 PIR over his last 3 and listed in the travelling squad for Kaunas. The Zalgiris defence (DRtg rank 1) caps his ceiling, but selling him costs more than it gains.

Balanced over the two nights: 5 play Thursday (Bryant, Nunn, the two centres, Rogkavopoulos) and 5 Friday (Feliz, Vezenkov, Brizuela, Jackson, Davidovac), so on Friday you can swap Feliz ⇄ Brizuela or Vezenkov ⇄ Jackson/Davidovac on late news.

review: R12: your squad (Variation B of the 17 Nov report) scored 206, so you reached the 200 target. Variation A would have scored 194, against 152 predicted. Captain Vezenkov's 41 (90 points doubled, with the win bonus) was the best possible captain. Maledon (26) and Diarra (24) beat their projections; Malcolm (6) and Rogkavopoulos (−1) were the misses. Projection error was 5.6 PIR per player (bias +0.7). Lesson kept: bigs returning to a full role (Kamenjas) are under-projected, and players coming back from injury (Rogkavopoulos) are over-projected. This report started from your real squad (from the screenshot), not the assumed one, because the tracking had Robinson and Joksimović wrongly. Research: ≈20 searches, 8 pages read, 6 players unverified.
window_plan: The rebuild's best plan sells Nunn, Brizuela, Malcolm, Rogkavopoulos and Davidovac for Bryant, Frisch, Herrera, Edwin Jackson and Marinković, with coach Martinez (RMB): about 9.7% a round over R14–R16. Variation A already buys Bryant and Edwin Jackson, so the window costs fewer changes. I'd wait on Robinson until Hayes's role is clear, and re-buy Maledon or Diarra only on full minutes this round. Nothing has to be bought before the window: the price moves are too small to matter.
